CREATE TABLE "product_information" (
"Item Code" INTEGER,
  "Item Name" TEXT,
  "Category Code" INTEGER,
  "Category Name" TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE "product_loss" (
"Item Code" INTEGER,
  "Item Name" TEXT,
  "Loss Rate (%)" REAL
)

CREATE TABLE "purchase_price" (
"Date" TIMESTAMP,
  "Item Code" INTEGER,
  "Wholesale price (yuan/kg)" REAL
)

CREATE TABLE "sales_records" (
"Sales Date" TIMESTAMP,
  "Time of sale (code scan)" TIME,
  "Item Code" INTEGER,
  "Sales volume (kg)" REAL,
  "Unit price (yuan/kg)" REAL,
  "Sales type" TEXT,
  "Whether sold at a discount" TEXT
)
